entities.summary: Château de Selles-sur-Cher is a castle (château) located in the commune of Selles-sur-Cher, Loir-et-Cher, Centre Region, France. The château is privately owned and is a designated historical monument of France. Château de Selles-sur-Cher is a château from Europe, created circa 1612. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
